frontend.title: My Journey into IT
frontend.content_development: My interest in technology combined with design led me to front-end development. I discovered a world where creativity naturally meets logic. I enjoy transforming design concepts into modern, responsive, and interactive websites. But front-end development is not my final destination. I want to keep learning, experimenting with new technologies, and gradually expand my skills into application development, working with AI, and other areas that combine technology with creative work.

workflow.content_AI: I also use artificial intelligence tools in my work. I see AI as a useful assistant, particularly for making quick code adjustments and refinements or automating routine tasks. Working with AI opens up new technological possibilities and provides inspiration for further growth. AI helps me work more efficiently, while I remain in control of the creative direction, important decisions, and communication with the client.

UX.title: Design that makes sense
UX.content_design: If I had to characterize my creative style, I would choose the combination minimalist design. I believe that every element—whether in digital or any other form—should have a clear purpose. My goal is to create visually clean and uncluttered websites where visitors feel at ease and can easily navigate the content.

graphic.title: From Design to Physical Product
graphic.content_graphicPrint: I have been working in Graphic Design for many years, and I also studied it professionally. I most often design flyers, posters, invitations, business cards, logos, and other products, particularly for promotional purposes. I also enjoy creating keepsakes and decorative items from plywood and paper. Thanks to my experience in Print Production, I understand not only the design itself, but also the entire production process. I prepare artwork for both small-format and large-format printing, plotter and laser cutting, textile printing, and engraving. I pay close attention to the thoughtful selection of colors, materials, and production techniques – from the initial concept to the final realization.

offer.title: Let's create together
offer.content_build: Does my approach appeal to you? Let’s work together to turn ideas into products that are clear, visually appealing, and functional. Together, we will find a solution that resonates with your target audience and supports your business.
offer.content_form: Do you have an idea or a question, or would you simply like to discuss the possibilities? Please get in touch using no-obligation form. Filling it out takes about a minute, and it helps me better understand how I can assist you.

inspiration.title: About the SenseSpace Project
inspiration.content: SenseSpace is my personal space where I bring together front-end development, UX/UI design, and graphic design. It is a place for personal projects, experimenting with technology, and exploring ways to combine functionality, aesthetics, and meaningful design. The name SenseSpace reflects a space where creativity, technology, and curiosity come together. To me, the universe symbolizes infinite possibilities, the freedom to explore, but also order and underlying principles – much like the world in which I create.

learn.title: What did I learn from this project?
learn.content_learn: This project helps me gain practical experience with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript—specifically DOM manipulation and the creation of event listeners, interactive components, modal windows, sliders, and responsive layouts using HTML/CSS Grid. I am improving my ability to debug code and solve common front-end development issues.
learn.content_living: This is a living project. I am gradually developing it based on what I learn. Do you have an idea for improvement or have you found a bug? I appreciate any constructive feedback.

bestshop.title: Responsive Website with Calculator
bestshop.technology: My first project using HTML, SCSS, and JavaScript.
bestshop.content_design: I designed BestShop with a focus on clean aesthetics, a clear structure, and an intuitive user experience. The visual style employs bold accents and modern elements that convey a sense of dynamic growth, service quality, and a rapid return on investment.
bestshop.content_code: During development, I prioritized clean, well-organized code, responsive display across all devices, and intuitive controls. I also used JavaScript to create an interactive calculator that helps visitors easily navigate the pricing options.
